changelog: Tap the voice-input language on the main screen to switch dictation language — the label is now a tappable pill showing the flag and language name (for example: Voice input: 🇧🇩 বাংলা) instead of the raw code, and tapping it opens the same Auto + 17-language picker as Settings. Picking a language saves it straight away. While recording, the picker waits until you stop, because the running recorder keeps the language it started with.
